message.reasoning_content:
I'm president, need influence. Bribe 5M to gain influence? Round 5, cash 12.8M. Bribe 5M gives +1 influence, helps final 5% bonus and presidency next law. Who to bribe? To opponent gives them cash — worse for ranking? Payout based on cash+hard rank weights 50:30:15, so giving opponent cash lowers my rank. But influence determines presidency/veto and max-influence bonus 5%.

Vote weight currently [3,3,1] — I have 3, faction1 has 3. Bribe 5M gives me +1 influence → weight 4 vs 3, presidency secured. But giving 5M to faction... bribe goes "to" recipient — to myself? Probably bribe to other faction. Could bribe to faction 2 (last place, weight 1) to gain influence without strengthening the rival. Cost 5M to them, I get +1 influence.

Alternative: produce goods to sell next market (round 5 market already passed? Order: market, action, law each round. We're in action round 5, market round 5 done, next market round 6. Produce 2 goods, sell next round at price ~9-10 after tax. ~2*9*0.9≈16 alashi? Wait prices are alashi per unit where 1M units = 1 alashi... prices [12,10,9...] alashi per unit — huge. So 2 goods ≈ 18+ alashi = 18M+? Cash 12.8M = ~12.8 alashi. So producing 2 goods worth ~2*10=20 alashi = 20M. That's big!

So produce is highly valuable: 2 goods × ~9-10 alashi each. Shuttle gives 3+ goods, 25% confiscation risk — EV 3*0.75=2.25 < 2? No wait shuttle gives 3 goods vs produce 2. EV goods: shuttle 2.25 < produce 2? No, 2.25 > 2. Wait 25% chance entire shuttle confiscated. EV = 3*0.75 = 2.25 goods vs 2. Slightly better, plus black tariff risk none. Shuttle EV slightly better. But risk. Also goods are worth ~10 alashi each = 10M. Difference EV = 0.25*10 = 2.5M. Choose shuttle.
